faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Jammu JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Jammu is 17th September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. or equivalent degree in Mathematics with at least 6 CGPA or 55 percent marks. Additionally, they must have qualified in GATE or CSIR-UGC NET.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the JRF post is 28 years. Age relaxations are applicable for SC/ST/Women/Physically Handicapped candidates (5 years) and OBC NCL candidates (3 years).

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of INR 37,000 plus 18% HRA per month. The position is initially for one year and can be extended based on performance.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the IIT Jammu JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official application portal of IIT Jammu. The link is provided in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the information available, no specific application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF role at IIT Jammu?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on merit and project requirements, followed by an interview, which may be conducted online or offline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the duration of the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The position is initially for a period of one year. It can be extended based on satisfactory performance, and the tenure is co-terminus with the project.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Official Notification PDF' link provided in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the project for which this JRF position is advertised?
faq.answer: This JRF position is for a project titled "Moduli space and deformation of bundles on an orbifold curve" at IIT Jammu.
